releaseNotes:
1. Multi-Slab GST Percentage Breakdown: Register cart summary and thermal receipts now itemize each GST slab separately (e.g. 5%, 12%, 18%, 28%) instead of a hardcoded 5% label, and local product add/edit persists GST & active status in SQLite.
2. Cloud Store Manager Catalog Parity: Added Brand, SKU Code, Low Stock Alert, GST Tax Slab, Upload File photo support, and styled Delete Confirmation modal on pospro.plannestapp.com matching the local POS app.
